summary: Backend passes all 513 tests with sound tenancy isolation, timing-safe crypto, and RLS enforcement. ProblemDetailsFilter omits ZodError/HttpException mapping and error logging; AuthGuard reads config from env instead of DI. Frontend has duplicate ApiError class and rate-limit logic flaw in telemetry.

findings.summary: Filter does not use toProblem() to map ZodErrors, HttpExceptions, or unknown errors; only handles DomainError per AC-M00-06.
findings.resolution: Filter rewritten on toProblem() mapper chain; 5xx logged + hasError set; Retry-After; regression tests in test/kernel/problem-filter.spec.ts

findings.summary: Filter does not log 5xx errors ('http.unhandled_error') or set RequestContext.hasError; spec §3.2 requires this.
findings.resolution: Filter rewritten on toProblem() mapper chain; 5xx logged + hasError set; Retry-After; regression tests in test/kernel/problem-filter.spec.ts

findings.summary: Filter does not set Retry-After header for RateLimitedError or DependencyUnavailableError per spec §3.2.
findings.resolution: Filter rewritten on toProblem() mapper chain; 5xx logged + hasError set; Retry-After; regression tests in test/kernel/problem-filter.spec.ts

findings.summary: Line 93 and 124: AuthGuard reads ACTOR_PEPPER directly from process.env instead of injecting KernelConfig.actorPepper; violates DI and skips config validation.
ErrorState defines ApiError class locally instead of importing from lib/api/api-error.ts; creates duplicate with maintenance risk.
Function loadConfig is 68 lines; exceeds lint target of 60, violates clean code rule in 01-standards §3.
Rate limit window resets based on lastFlushTime, not per minute; max-per-minute cap is checked per batch, not rolling window per spec §7.
Frontend code uses 'as any' type assertions in non-test files; violates 01-standards §3 'No any' rule.
Frontend tests use 'as any' for mock assertions; should use proper typing or type guards.
